_about: What each building module's icon (a station's Upgrade tab, the module messages) shows, for Tools/LocalSpawn/generate_item_icons.py --set modules. One object, seen in three-quarter view from slightly above, Norse and hand-made, described by its looks and by the one thing that tells it apart at 64 px. Modules are fittings for a building, never a whole building.
module.storageloft: A small wooden storage loft: a sturdy plank platform on two square posts with a short ladder leaning on it, stacked with a wrapped bundle, a small sack and a coil of rope on top, rough pale planks and dark iron nails
module.apprenticescorner: A small apprentice's workbench: a low wooden bench with a leather apron hung over its edge, a little hammer, tongs and a wooden mallet laid on top, a three-legged stool beside it
module.wisplantern: An iron-framed Norse lantern with panes of thin horn, glowing inside with a pale cold blue-white wisp of light, a ring at the top to hang it, faint cold mist curling from it
module.hagsknot: A large pale charm: thick cream-coloured hag-hair cord tied in a big tangled witch's knot around a grey river stone with a hole, two white bone beads and a sprig of green moss on it, hung from a leather thong, a soft eerie green glow around the knot
module.ironbands: Two heavy black iron corner straps for a timber wall, bent at a right angle with big round rivet heads, wrapped around the end of a squared oak beam
module.masonsframe: A mason's wooden squaring frame: an open rectangular timber frame with a set square and a plumb bob on a string, a half-cut grey stone block resting in it, stone chips around
module.kitbench: A small wooden bench laid out for field kits: two matching leather kit rolls tied with cord side by side, a spool of linen thread and a small iron awl beside them
module.framesaw: A Norse bow saw for planks: a wide rectangular wooden H-frame, a thin straight toothed steel blade stretched along its bottom edge, a twisted rope with a wooden toggle across the top, standing upright, three neat pale planks leaning beside it
module.eldergraft: A living graft on a wooden post: a pale root cutting bound with twine onto a squared lodge post, sprouting small fresh green leaves and a faint soft golden glow
module.fletchersjig: A fletcher's jig: a small wooden clamp holding an arrow shaft upright with three grey mistwing feathers being set, a bundle of finished arrows tied beside it
module.antlerwall: A pair of large stag antlers mounted on a small round wooden shield plaque, hung by a cord, the antlers wide and many-pointed
module.spinningwheel: A small upright Norse spinning wheel on a slanted wooden bench with three legs: a light wooden spoked wheel at one end, a foot treadle under it, and a bundle of pale flax on a tall distaff stick at the other end, a spool of thread
module.widowsilklacing: A coil of fine pale grey spider silk cord laced through a piece of brown leather with neat stitched holes, a bone needle stuck in it, the silk faintly shining
module.herbrack: A small wooden drying rack with bunches of green healing herbs hung upside down by twine from its crossbar
module.runeshelf: A short wooden shelf on two brackets holding three small clay jars and a corked bottle, each jar marked with a carved rune, a bone lying in front
module.runestonering: A low ring of cut grey granite blocks around a small upright runestone fragment carved with glowing pale blue runes
module.maptable: A small wooden table with a parchment map spread on it, held flat by a stone and a dagger, a few carved wooden markers and a runestone chip on the map
module.mistwingquilts: A thick folded patchwork quilt of linen squares, stuffed and puffed, grey mistwing feathers poking from a seam, laid on a short bench
module.boxbeds: A Norse box bed built of planks with a small sliding wooden door half open, showing a straw mattress and a fur blanket inside
module.scarecrow: A small scarecrow on a pole: crossed sticks in an old patched linen shirt, a straw-stuffed sack head with a wide-brimmed straw hat, barley ears tied at its feet
